scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(inscripcion_id) AS inscripcion_id,
    TRIM(ci_beneficiaria) AS ci_beneficiaria,
    TRIM(establecimiento_id) AS establecimiento_id,
    TRIM(fecha_inscripcion) AS fecha_inscripcion,
    TRIM(semana_gestacion) AS semana_gestacion,
    TRIM(estado) AS estado
FROM bronze.bja_inscripciones
WHERE inscripcion_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(inscripcion_id) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(pago_id) AS pago_id,
    TRIM(ci_beneficiaria) AS ci_beneficiaria,
    TRIM(concepto_pago) AS concepto_pago,
    TRIM(monto_bs) AS monto_bs,
    TRIM(fecha_pago) AS fecha_pago,
    TRIM(estado_pago) AS estado_pago,
    TRIM(canal_pago) AS canal_pago,
    TRIM(nro_comprobante) AS nro_comprobante
FROM bronze.bja_pagos
WHERE pago_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pago_id) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(parto_id) AS parto_id,
    TRIM(ci_madre) AS ci_madre,
    TRIM(ci_recien_nacido) AS ci_recien_nacido,
    TRIM(establecimiento_id) AS establecimiento_id,
    TRIM(fecha_parto) AS fecha_parto,
    TRIM(tipo_parto) AS tipo_parto,
    TRIM(peso_nacimiento_kg) AS peso_nacimiento_kg,
    TRIM(talla_nacimiento_cm) AS talla_nacimiento_cm
FROM bronze.bja_partos
WHERE parto_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(parto_id) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(CI) AS CI,
    TRIM(Nombres) AS Nombres,
    TRIM(Ap_Patern) AS Ap_Patern,
    TRIM(Ap_Matern) AS Ap_Matern,
    TRIM(Fecha_Nac) AS Fecha_Nac,
    TRIM(Genero) AS Genero,
    TRIM(Estado_Civ) AS Estado_Civ,
    TRIM(Municipio) AS Municipio
FROM bronze.segip
WHERE CI IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CI) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(boleta_id) AS boleta_id,
    TRIM(control_id) AS control_id,
    TRIM(ci_beneficiaria) AS ci_beneficiaria,
    TRIM(nro_boleta) AS nro_boleta,
    TRIM(fecha_emision) AS fecha_emision,
    TRIM(estado) AS estado
FROM bronze.sup_boletas
WHERE boleta_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(boleta_id) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(paquete_id) AS paquete_id,
    TRIM(nombre) AS nombre,
    TRIM(contenido) AS contenido,
    TRIM(peso_estandar_kg) AS peso_estandar_kg,
    TRIM(costo_estimado_bs) AS costo_estimado_bs
FROM bronze.sup_catalogo_paquetes
WHERE paquete_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(paquete_id) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(control_id) AS control_id,
    TRIM(ci_beneficiaria) AS ci_beneficiaria,
    TRIM(establecimiento_id) AS establecimiento_id,
    TRIM(nro_control) AS nro_control,
    TRIM(fecha_control) AS fecha_control,
    TRIM(semana_gestacion) AS semana_gestacion,
    TRIM(peso_madre_kg) AS peso_madre_kg,
    TRIM(presion_arterial) AS presion_arterial
FROM bronze.sup_controles
WHERE control_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(control_id) <> ''',

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(entrega_id) AS entrega_id,
    TRIM(boleta_id) AS boleta_id,
    TRIM(ci_beneficiaria) AS ci_beneficiaria,
    TRIM(establecimiento_id) AS establecimiento_id,
    TRIM(paquete_id) AS paquete_id,
    TRIM(paquete_nombre) AS paquete_nombre,
    TRIM(fecha_entrega) AS fecha_entrega,
    TRIM(lote_produccion) AS lote_produccion,
    TRIM(peso_paquete_kg) AS peso_paquete_kg,
    TRIM(fecha_proxima_entrega) AS fecha_proxima_entrega
FROM bronze.sup_entregas
WHERE entrega_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(entrega_id) <> ''',

fecha_proxima_entrega = iif(isNull(fecha_proxima_entrega) || fecha_proxima_entrega == 'NULL', toDate(null()), coalesce(toDate(fecha_proxima_entrega, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(fecha_proxima_entrega, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(fecha_proxima_entrega, 'dd/MM/yyyy'))),

query: 'SELECT 
    TRIM(establecimiento_id) AS establecimiento_id,
    TRIM(codigo_snis) AS codigo_snis,
    TRIM(nombre) AS nombre,
    TRIM(tipo) AS tipo,
    TRIM(nivel_atencion) AS nivel_atencion,
    TRIM(municipio) AS municipio,
    TRIM(departamento) AS departamento,
    TRIM(red_salud) AS red_salud
FROM bronze.sup_establecimientos
WHERE establecimiento_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(establecimiento_id) <> ''',
